adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /public/v2/company on the documented default US host.

EU and APAC hosts (public-api.eu.drata.com, public-api.apac.drata.com) are computed from a stored region enum whose US value is a different hostname shape, so they are not expressed. The native template pins public-api.drata.com.
Native category is productivity rather than security: Drata is compliance automation, but Rust CATEGORIES has no security bucket; admitted ops are company, workspace, personnel, and vendor reads.

Returns raw Drata JSON under data. expand[] array appends are omitted because the native query template cannot express repeated expand[] without unused inputs. sort/sortDir are omitted because official OpenAPI uses ASC/DESC while the pinned source enum is lowercase.
Returns raw Drata JSON under data. employmentStatus[] and complianceStatus[] array filters and expand[] are omitted. This is GET /personnel, not the OpenSearch personnel-search endpoints.

personnelId is a string path segment so integer IDs and email: prefixed identifiers can both be sent. The value is URL-encoded. expand[] is omitted. Upstream wraps the payload as {personnel, raw}; the native operation returns raw Drata JSON under data.
